row.title: GH-ONLY-1: Pages is turned on by the administration app
row.body: No org credential is bound in the core repository's Actions, so pages-enable.yml falls back to the OIDC route: repo-settings with pages=workflow, applied by applyStandard in seed/worker/src/repostandard.js.
